intro: I'm Shorty. I answer your customers, take preorders, and text your regulars. Grab me, or tap the phone, the truck, the sign.
burger: People preorder right from your app. You can make sales a week in advance, or make sure your rainy days still get sales. Once they order, payment is made and they're committed to showing up.
mega: I communicate for you 24/7: text messages, emails, and social media posts. One tap from you, or just text me what to say.
signTonight: That's tonight's stop, straight from your schedule.
signWeek: That's your week. It's one schedule: text me a change and your page and the truck finder both update.
truck1: Somebody just ordered ahead. Watch the truck.
truck2: That's a preorder landing. Your phone buzzes, the ticket shows at the truck. No commission on it.
outOfWindow: Out. I take the orders, I don't cook them.
intoWindow: Order up! Kidding. I don't cook. I take the orders, answer the questions, and text your regulars. Tap the truck to let me out.
cratePhone: This is me on your page. I answer your customers 24/7: menu, allergies, where you are tonight, order ahead.
intoPhone: This is me on your page. Customers ask what's good, what's gluten free, where you are tonight. I answer, and I take the order.
phoneOpen: This is a real page: schedule, menu, preorders. Tap around, and try a preorder.
orderStart: Watch. A customer opens your page.
orderPick: They pick a stop, then what they want.
orderPay: They pay right there. No commission.
orderTicket: You get the ticket. They skip the line.
install: No app store. They tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Your truck is an icon on their phone.
follow: Customers join your email list right on your page. With Communications they can opt in to texts too, so you can tell them when you're out.
askNumber: Tap Text me and watch what your customers would get. This is a demo: nothing is sent to your phone.
text0: Order ready. That one goes out by itself when you mark it done.
text1: Coming back to their area. One tap from you, every follower nearby.
text2: Reward your best customers. Shorty knows who they are from the orders.
text3: Tonight's stop. The same post that hits social, as a text.
textsDone: That's the set. Texts need Communications, $30 a month.
emailAsk: Type your email below and I'll show you the email your customers would get.
emailPreview: Email isn't switched on for this demo yet, so nothing was sent. That's what it would look like.
askFail: I couldn't reach my answers just now. Try one of the questions below, and ask me again in a minute.
landHard0: Oof. Customers still get answers while I'm down. I never go offline.
landHard1: Easy. Your page keeps taking preorders while I'm in the air.
landHard2: I'm fine. Your followers still get tonight's stop on time.
landHard3: Okay, okay. Your texts still go out when I'm upside down.
roofNoCount: Nice view. Every truck on the local truck pages is a page like yours.
c2: Keep Toast for walk-ups. We don't plug into it. Shortlist runs your page, your preorders, your followers, and how Google and AI find you. No commission.
c3: A finder is a list. You get your own page: menu, stops, preorders, followers, and me. The finder just sends people to it.
c4: Your page is free. Verified is $50 a month: preorders, online ordering, reports. Communications is $30 a month: texting and social posting. No commission on orders.
c5: Where you are, when, what you sell, 24/7. I take the orders, text people when their food's up, bring back the ones who went quiet, send the loyalty deals, email your week, post your stops. Text me and I do it.
c6: Yep. Text me 'post about the birria today' and it goes to Instagram and Facebook with your photo and tonight's stop. Social posting comes with Communications.
c7: People ask ChatGPT where to eat now. Your truck is in the answer, with tonight's stop, and they can start an order right there. Same on Google and the local truck pages.
